summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Asset CRUD (Edit/Delete) and Ticket Edit with Asset Selection features. All 19 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI testing verified all features working correctly including asset edit/delete dialogs and ticket edit modal with asset selection dropdown.
critical_code_review_comments: Asset CRUD endpoints properly implemented with history tracking
PATCH /api/assets/{asset_id} - Updates asset fields with history recording for each field change
DELETE /api/assets/{asset_id} - Admin-only deletion with open ticket check (returns 400 if open tickets exist)
PATCH /api/tickets/{ticket_id} - Extended to support title, description, category, priority, asset_id changes
Asset change on ticket is recorded in ticket_history collection
Fixed: asset_id can now be explicitly set to null to remove asset from ticket
Fixed: Ticket history endpoint now includes asset_change events from ticket_history collection
All data-testid attributes properly implemented for testing
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py - Fixed update_ticket to allow setting asset_id to null
/app/backend/server.py - Fixed get_ticket_history to include asset_change events
/app/backend/tests/test_asset_ticket_edit.py - New test file for asset/ticket edit features
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created and cleaned up TEST_ prefixed assets and tickets during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Asset CRUD and Ticket Edit features fully tested and working. Backend tests cover: PATCH /api/assets/{asset_id} (update brand, model, location, multiple fields), DELETE /api/assets/{asset_id} (success, not found, blocked by open tickets), PATCH /api/tickets/{ticket_id} (update title, description, category, priority, add/change/remove asset), GET /api/tickets/{ticket_id}/history (includes asset_change events), GET /api/assets/{asset_id}/history (includes field_change events). Frontend tests verified: Asset List page with edit/delete buttons, Asset Edit dialog with all form fields, Asset Delete confirmation dialog with open ticket warning, Ticket Detail page with Edit button, Ticket Edit modal with asset selection dropdown.
